# Season Shelf 1.2.12

- Folder pickers now reopen at the saved Download or Watch folder, including after restarting the app. If a saved folder was removed, the picker starts at its nearest existing parent.
- Replaced on/off preferences with switches for download notifications, tray behavior, download hours, automatic colors and shutdown after downloads.
- Short option lists now use visible radio choices for simultaneous downloads, text size and weight, and series-watch behavior.
- Preserved existing preferences, live appearance previews, download schedules and keyboard operation. Multi-item selections remain checkboxes.

Windows installations can update inside the app after publication. On macOS, download the universal DMG and replace the app in Applications. Builds remain unsigned.
